question: The diagram shows 3 blocks in contact on a smooth surface. A 230N force acts on block 1 from the left, and the surface can be considered frictionless. Calculate:
question_parts: The net force on each block
The contact forces for each block
answer_parts: The acceleration of the system is $10\,\mathrm{m s^{-2}}$
Each block has an acceleration of $10\,\mathrm{m s^{-2}}$

Block 1 has a net force of 70N
Block 2 has a net force of 70N
Block 3 has a net force of 90N

Block 1 has 2 forces acting on it. They are: 230N Applied, -160N Contact Force from block 0
Block 2 has 2 forces acting on it. They are: 160N Contact, -90N Contact Reaction
Block 3 has 1 force acting on it. They are: 90N Contact Force from block 2
